purposes.code_wm/1: system ID: 2 s hover with rate/thrust pulses, then datasheet-tuned path follower at 4 m/s along the relays (no fault compensation). Revealed delay, rate bias, thrust deficit, and the north-aisle jet that crashed it
purposes.code_wm/2: first controller synthesised in the life-1 code world (fault compensation + north-jet feed-forward; south aisle randomised +-13 m/s^2 since unknown). End-to-end test; revealed the south-aisle jet
purposes.code_wm/3: exploration for site generality: mission A route with probes into both aisle mouths (y +3 at z 4, y -3 at z 1.5) and canyon legs at z 4 / 1.5; route controller synthesised in the lives-1+2 world
purposes.code_wm/4: end-to-end test of the final mission-A controller (exactly the one evaluated), synthesised in the lives-1-3 world
purposes.code_wm/5: flown AFTER the official evaluation, for phase 2 only: deeper aisle probes (y +3.8 at z 3, y -3.8 at z 3.5); held-out fidelity data for the lives-1-3 world. Not used by the evaluated controller

fidelity_files: world fitted on life 1 only, scored on lives 1 (in-sample) and 2 (held out)
world fitted on lives 1-2, scored on 1-2 (in-sample) and 3 (held out; first flight into the aisle mouths)
lives-1-3 world (used for the evaluated controller)
controller_type: hand-written cascade policy (path following along start->relays, accel PD+I with code-world jet feed-forward, geometric attitude -> body-rate command, inverse of the fitted rate bias/gain, thrust deficit) whose 8 gains were chosen by cross-entropy search over imagined lives in the code world with domain randomisation (jets +-30 %, jet position +-0.4 m, rate bias +-0.05, thrust +-3 %, delay +-0.2 steps, drag +-0.08, OU gusts 1 m/s^2, sensor noise)

mechanisms.name: command delay
mechanisms.evidence: life 1 hover pulses and cruise: least squares w[t+1] on (w[t], a[t], a[t-1], a[t-2]) gives coefficient 0.004 on a[t] and 0.88 on a[t-1] (pitch axis); fitted 1.00 on life 1 alone, 1.00 on lives 1-2, 1.04 on lives 1-3

mechanisms.name: constant body-rate bias (aircraft fault)
mechanisms.evidence: steady cruise of life 1 (t 3-6.5 s): the controller had to command about (+0.5, -0.5, +0.27) rad/s to hold zero measured rates; fitted per data set: life 1 (-0.50, +0.49, -0.24), lives 1-2 (-0.50, +0.50, -0.25), lives 1-3 (-0.52, +0.52, -0.26). the life-1 fit loss fell from 589 (datasheet values) to 33 within 50 gradient steps, by which time bias and thrust gain had converged while the jet term had not
mechanisms.interpretation: the unit drifts left-side-down, nose-down and clockwise unless countered: consistent with an asymmetric thrust/torque from a damaged rotor (maintenance flag); which motor is not identified

mechanisms.name: thrust deficit (aircraft fault)
mechanisms.evidence: vertical force balance in life 1 hover and cruise (residual -1.3 m/s^2 with datasheet thrust); hover needs T = 0.32 instead of 0.30; fitted 0.877 (l1), 0.879 (l1-2), 0.875 (l1-3)

mechanisms.name: rate loop
mechanisms.evidence: gain matches the datasheet (0.88-0.92); once the 1-step delay is modelled the remaining lag is small (weakly identified)

mechanisms.name: drag and uniform wind
mechanisms.evidence: x-residual about -1.2 m/s^2 at 6 m/s cruise (lives 2, 4); drag and a uniform wind trade off and are not separately identified; net effect small

mechanisms.name: north-aisle jet (site)
mechanisms.evidence: life 1 crashed into the south wall at x 24.2 after a y-acceleration residual of -9 to -11 m/s^2 between x 21 and 24 (pushed toward -y out of the north side aisle at x 22-25.5); crossed again in lives 2-5, probed into the aisle mouth in lives 3 and 5. Gaussian-in-x fit: life 1 -11.4 m/s^2; lives 1-2 -13.7; lives 1-3 (with height and depth terms) -16.7 at the mouth, weaker with height (GZ -0.11 per m) and spreading little. Open-loop 1 s error on life 1: datasheet 1.22 m -> 0.07-0.11 m
mechanisms.confidence: high (existence, sign, location); medium (strength, shape); unsteady: within the jet one-step y-acceleration residual stays 1.5-2 m/s^2 rms

mechanisms.name: south-aisle jet (site)
mechanisms.evidence: first seen in life 2: y-acceleration residual +9 m/s^2 at x 39-41 (pushed toward +y, out of the south side aisle at x 38-41.5); fitted +11.7 on lives 1-2, +10.4 on lives 1-3; probed at z 1.5 (life 3) and z 3.5 (life 5)

mechanisms.name: sensor noise
mechanisms.evidence: second differences of logged position (0.02 m per sample) and velocity (0.02-0.07 m/s; larger in y) in life 1; used only in controller synthesis

mechanisms.name: unmodelled residual flow
mechanisms.evidence: not fitted: chosen to cover the 1.5-2 m/s^2 rms y-residual inside the jets; synthesis-only randomisation
mechanisms.confidence: low (it is an uncertainty model, not a measurement)

extra.real_steps_per_life_note: lives 1-4 (1202 steps) preceded the evaluation; life 5 (452 steps) was flown after it for phase 2
extra.eval_failure_note: the one failed eval episode (seed 1038, timeout, 1 relay) passed relay 2 at about 1.2 m and then hovered at x 33.7: when a relay is missed the path follower's along-track pull back to the relay and its forward speed reference cancel (a deadlock in my controller logic, not a world error). The same failure mode is present in the code world (1.5 % timeouts of the final controller in imagination). Not fixed, since it was seen on an evaluation seed.
